r5_lines_as_printed: Across the 23 shared items, agents with an emem reference did not act on 276 of 276 corrupted handoffs (240 declined, 36 used the genuine record); with an opaque id, 122 of 276; in prose, 22 of 276.

Figure: Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 pooled, full item set per condition. 2,794 scored trials (1 Oct 2026, two constructed tasks) span 25 corruption items, controls, exploratory items and Qwen. The emem lane adds a verifier and an instruction. Matched baseline (4 Oct): a JSON receiver with emem’s checks minus hash, signature and log accepted 8 of 23 (3 with four more checks; emem 0); instructed Haiku agents with it acted on the same 8. With a fail-closed resolver, Qwen2.5-7B still acted on 10 of 25 (2 of 25 instructed): enforce refusal outside the model.

JSON and an opaque id caught some changes from their fields. On the live pre-fix record, agents acted 4 of 4 times uninstructed, 2 of 4 with resolve-and-bind instructions and 0 of 4 with a source re-read.
